label: The smoke cycle: the journey lane captures a path from an explorer, admits it after two runs, and proposes it as a generated suite in a pull request that the owner reviews and merges; CI runs the suite per browser project on every pull request and uploads its results; the lane reads those results, decides whether a break is a flake, a UI change or a bug, and proposes a quarantine, a heal or a baseline, or files a regression, again as a pull request.
desc: One smoke cycle of /journey smoke has three places. In the lane, run from the main session on an instance of its own, smoke plan ranks the catalog and marks the journeys that need a path; a ui-explorer charted with path: wanted returns a path; smoke admit runs it twice, on a fresh and then a used instance, and stages it; smoke run re-runs the suite's paths in a seeded order, and with --perf measures them on Chrome; smoke propose checks every file and the pull request body with scrub and opens one pull request on an argus branch. In your repo, you review that pull request: merging accepts it, closing rejects it and the same change is never proposed again. In CI, the generated workflow runs the suite on every pull request: a matrix of browser projects in the pinned Playwright container (chromium, firefox, webkit, further viewports, a11y and i18n), msedge on the plain runner without screenshots, a non-gating quarantine job, and a baseline job that only a dispatch starts; each uploads its results for seven days. Back in the lane, smoke ci triages the run: a flake on the base branch is quarantined, never hidden; a moved control is healed after the unchanged expectations hold twice; a lost control or a failed expectation becomes a regression candidate that is replayed two of two and filed only after scrub finds no secret; a screenshot or ARIA difference is the owner's call; a missing baseline starts the baseline run, whose files smoke baseline adopts into a pull request that the owner reviews in the image view. Nothing is applied at run time, and sapu never merges a proposal.
title: /journey smoke — one smoke cycle
